detail.title: 专业工具验证
detail.workflow: Read designcraft_editor state before editing and copy its CURRENT view.base including engine and selectionStamp. objectIds belong to sourceId; nativeSelection preserves the real engine selection. Use the declared native coordinateSpace and selection transforms, not preview pixels or assumed Vector coordinates. Large uint64 IDs are decimal strings; use {$u64:"decimal-id"} in command params, never Number(id). Re-read after page/source/revision/selection context changes. Keep manual changes; do not modify files or dcDoc behind the live App. Completion needs the actual native checkpoint.
